p.em: the codebase uses "epoch" for two unrelated mechanisms — keep them apart

text.tspan: ① is about WHEN memory is safe to free;
② is about HOW the WAL is segmented for checkpoints.
PURPOSE: safe memory reclamation + snapshot reads
HOW: a reader pins the current epoch; a superseded
version is reclaimed only after every reader pinned
at its epoch has left. (Overlay nodes are ALSO
Arc-refcounted, so this layer gates snapshot
transactions + eviction, not basic node freeing.)
HOW: the WAL is divided into per-epoch segments
